copyright: Based on the Frontier station representative cloak (ClothingNeckCloakSr), created by GentleButter for Frontier Station. Original silhouette, collar, folds and direction layouts preserved; rear repair crew emblem is a golden circular badge with a pale symmetrical industrial symbol based on the supplied reference.
